publicationScope: Documentation and coverage index only; no runtime, flag, default or rule activation. Proposed owners are not active claims.

completeness.indexCoverage: All extracted chapter/section/explicit-article headings and official summary rows. Subitems/notes/exceptions remain in authoritative text.

source.proof: PDF cover and preface explicitly state rules in effect for the2026NFLseason

statusMeanings.not_individually_qualified: Indexed but not individually adjudicated against code and legal controls; not proof of absence or compliance.
statusMeanings.partial_model: Some related runtime behavior exists; full article coverage and exceptions are not certified.
statusMeanings.sampled_dead_ball_abstraction: Sampled game-level flag, not a native achieved-movement detector.
statusMeanings.type_only: Name exists without a native detector/resolver.
statusMeanings.controller_guard_not_officiating: Local technique constraint; no general foul adjudication.
statusMeanings.unresolved: Required legal fact is absent/unsupported; never silently treat as legal.

currentImplementationFacts.detail: Four penalty names, one optional penalty; game resolves offensive holding and sampled presnap subset. Multiple/offset/possession-phase call lists are absent.

Discipline-conditioned chosen grab and separate visibility roll; no independent record for uncalled chosen holding. This does not qualify every material-restraint element or all ordinary physical hands.
Game samples false_start/offside; both are dead ball. Native encroachment/NZI/live offside distinctions are not implemented by this path.
DPI exists in types but no src producer or generic enforcement branch was found.
Press release retires beyond five yards/after throw/scramble and forbids cloth tension in its own joint. This is not general illegal-contact/DPI coverage.
No general OPI, defensive holding, illegal contact, roughing, blindside/back/low/chop, facemask, horse-collar or hip-drop detector found. This does not prove every represented contact illegal.
Reach query/collection success and center-inbounds are not complete catch/control/feet/ground chronology.
No general legal forward-pass/grounding detector; fumble advance and boundary/impetus exceptions need explicit qualification.
Kick/punt/FG outcomes are not native kick-contact/formation/fair-catch officiating.
Reduced pair/impulse/closing records lack exact anatomical contact/grip history; preserve unknowns instead of guessing head/neck/back/waist/leg-trap facts.
